name: Agrona

attributes.attribute: kin of the death queen Mórrígan
gave her name to the Welsh battle-god Aeron
known in early lore as Agroná

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Agrona, known in early lore as Agroná, was a British goddess of slaughter. She appears in Britain and in Wales. Her name gave the Welsh battle-god Aeron his title. Some scholars describe her as kin of the Irish death queen Mórrígan.

okr.objective: Record the obscure British war goddess Agrona.
key_results: Show her homelands and her link to the Mórrígan.
Note that her name passed to the Welsh god Aeron.
